d: Pale ash blonde hair is long and straight with blunt bangs and a side-swept parting. The eyes are a light, muted blue with a blank, neutral expression on a face with the apparent age of a young adolescent. The build is slender, dressed in a dark charcoal grey outfit consisting of a high-collared sleeveless tunic, a cropped puffer vest, a matching peaked cap with "511" written on it, and thigh-high stockings. Signature details include a dark grey mechanical rig featuring metal hull plating and a small antenna protruding from the headgear.
